messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden TPM spike detected for model family sable-13b in us-east-1. 1m TPM=3.8k (baseline 1.2k). Per-model queue latency and 5xx rate increasing. Auto-escalation triggered.

maria: ack, oncall here. paging eng-sre + runtime. taking ownership for initial mitigation.

tom: oncall-sre joining. can you post region breakdown and top offending tenant IDs?

maria: mostly us-east-1 (75% of excess), some traffic in us-west-2. top tenants: tenant-acme, tenant-zetta, tenant-labs (approx IDs truncated).

ops-bot: ticket TKT-4592 created for incident tracking — "sable-13b high-tpm live mitigation".

tom: plan: 1) immediate temporary per-family rate cap on sable-13b: TPM 1200 -> 300, RPM 2000 -> 600. 2) canary in us-east-1, then roll to other regions if stable. 3) add allowlist overrides for critical tenants. 4) monitor 95p latency and 5xx.

lee: +1. Add fallback route to quantized/smaller variant to reduce 429s. Also ensure KV cache isn't being invalidated repeatedly (sable has some regrowth).

maria: given customer impact, do canary now please. @tom you have the keys.

 tom: running admin change now.

 tom: ```
# admin CLI
rwctl model adjust-rate --family sable-13b --tpm 300 --rpm 600 --regions us-east-1 --reason "live mitigation 2048123456"
```

oms: also available via admin API:

 tom: ```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/models/adjust-rate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \\n  -d '{"family":"sable-13b","tpm":300,"rpm":600,"regions":["us-east-1"],"reason":"live mitigation 2048123456"}'
```

 tom: done — change id adj-2048123456-1 applied to us-east-1 at 2048123520.

ops-bot: Change adj-2048123456-1 applied by tom at 2048123520. Monitoring hooks active: dashboards/rate/adj-2048123456-1 (link).

maria: observing immediate improvements: us-east-1 per-model queue length down ~72%, 95p latency down 520ms -> 210ms, 5xx down 1.8% -> 0.9%. Looks promising.

sara: support note: we already have inbound tickets from tenant-acme and tenant-zetta reporting 429s. Drafting a targeted message to affected customers and will update status page.

dan: product: what's the expected SLA impact? Are any enterprise customers at risk of degraded availability vs correctness?

tom: short answer: degraded throughput for some heavy workloads; correctness unaffected. A small fraction (~1%) of requests now get 429 for particularly heavy tenants. We're enabling tenant-level overrides for partners who need uninterrupted throughput.

maria: can we allowlist tenant-acme for short term? they have a demo in 40m.

lee: we can apply a tenant override. running: 

lee: ```
rwctl tenant override --tenant acme-inc --model-family sable-13b --tpm 800 --duration 2h --reason "partner workaround"
```

lee: override applied — ov-2048123588. tenant-acme now at 800 TPM for 2h.

sara: support: acme notified, they confirmed reduced errors. posting incident update to status page and opening high-touch support case.

 tom: next step: roll mitigation to us-west-2, then global if good. Applying to us-west-2 now.

ops-bot: adj-2048123456-2 applied to us-west-2 at 2048123605.

 tom: applying global caps in 60s.

 tom: adj-2048123456-3 global apply complete.

maria: good. system-wide metrics look stable: global 95p latency reduced to ~230ms, global 5xx ~1.0%. Keep cap for 45 minutes, then slowly increase TPM in 2 steps if stable.

lee: added fallback routing rule so requests that would be rate-limited go to sable-quant-7b for non-critical flows. rule id fb-2048123650.

 tom: note for post-incident: autoscaler slower than needed due to shard imbalance and cold warmup of some nodes. Follow-up action: tune shard balancing and pre-warm policy. Filing follow-up ticket TKT-4593.

maria: communications: @sara please publish status and send targeted notices to tenants that saw 429. Include workaround (tenant override, alternate model family) and ETA for rollback.

sara: drafting now. Subject: "Temporary rate limits on sable-13b" — will include link to support case and explanation.

ops-bot: snapshot metrics attached to TKT-4592 (link).

 tom: handoff: I'll take 1hr watch and be primary for SRE mitigation. Trigger rollback if any of: global 95p latency >350ms, global 5xx >1.5%, or queue length re-increases >40% from baseline.

maria: thanks. I'm switching to follow-up tasks but reachable. If stable after 45m we'll ramp TPM 300 -> 600 -> 1000 in staged increments.

dan: we'll review capacity planning and partner communication tomorrow in postmortem.

maria: closing this thread for active mitigation. continuing monitoring in TKT-4592. :thumbsup:

tom: ack, monitoring.

ops-bot: Incident TKT-4592 updated: mitigation applied, owner=tom, snooze alarms for adj-2048123456-*.
